title: RackWalker scene contract
description: Source of truth for every body exchanged between web/ and proxy/. Contract version 2.2.0 (2.0.0, the first public contract, plus the game shell: player sessions and game state; 2.2.0 adds the site country for the overworld). Change only by contract change; see contracts/README.md.

IsoCoord.description: Tile coordinate on the parent grid; null = not placed yet (the engine auto-lays out, deterministically, and never writes that back unless the user drags).

IsoSize.description: Size in tiles; null = engine default.

IsoFacing.description: Grid direction the front faces. N = -y (screen up-right), E = +x (screen down-right), S = +y (screen down-left), W = -x (screen up-left). See contracts/iso.md.

NetboxUrl.description: Absolute link to the object in the NetBox web UI (for 'open in NetBox'); null when unknown.

PortKind.description: Short name of the NetBox termination model (dcim.interface -> interface, dcim.frontport -> front_port, circuits.circuittermination -> circuit_termination, ...). (kind, id) is unique; id alone is not.

netbox_version.description: Version reported by NetBox /api/status/, e.g. 4.7.4; null for fixtures.

source.description: cache = served from the proxy read cache.

status.description: NetBox status value: planned|staging|active|decommissioning|retired (sites may define more).

iso_theme.description: Custom field iso_theme; null = app default theme.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the site (custom field iso_country, else the site's own region as a two-letter code or a country name, else the last line of its physical address); null = unknown. Picks the overworld's landmark and villager set.

unracked_devices.description: Devices in the site with rack_id null or position null (0U devices count here too).

cables.description: Cables with at least one termination in the site.

Location.description: A NetBox Location, drawn as a room. iso_* are custom fields; coordinates are tiles on the site grid.

parent_id.description: Parent location (NetBox locations nest); null = top level.

iso_facing.description: Side of the room that has the door.

Rack.description: A NetBox Rack. One tile footprint. iso_x/iso_y are tiles on the location grid (relative to the location origin) or on the site grid when location_id is null.

starting_unit.description: Number of the lowest U (NetBox default 1).

desc_units.description: true when units are numbered top to bottom.

slug.description: Sprite choice keys off the slug: switch, router, firewall, server, patch-panel, pdu (others fall back to device_<n>u).

color.description: NetBox role colour, lower-case hex without #.

position.description: Lowest U occupied; null with rack_id set = zero-U / non-racked in that rack.

Termination.description: One end of a cable or a trace hop.

name.description: Port name; for a circuit termination the side, A or Z.

site_id.description: Lets the engine see that a cable leaves the site.

Interface.description: Any cable-able port of a device (an interface in the wide sense); kind also covers patch-panel front/rear ports, console and power ports.

enabled.description: Always true for kinds without an enabled flag.

mgmt_only.description: Always false for kinds other than interface.

link_peers.description: The far side of this port's own cable (one hop).

connected_endpoint.description: End of the whole path through patch panels/circuits (NetBox connected_endpoints[0]); null if the path is incomplete or the kind has none.

type.description: cat6, mmf-om4, smf-os2, dac-passive, power, ... (NetBox cable type).

color.description: Lower-case hex without #; null = theme wire colour.

TraceHop.description: One segment of NetBox's /trace/: near end(s) -> cable -> far end(s).

cable.description: null for a segment with no cable (e.g. a circuit's provider network).

far_end.description: Empty when the path stops here.

hops.description: In order from the origin. A port with no cable (NetBox /trace/ returns []) has hops [], is_complete false, is_split false; the origin is still set.

is_complete.description: The path reaches an endpoint (interface, console/power endpoint, provider network).

is_split.description: The path fans out (e.g. a rear port with several positions); hops stop at the split.

WorldLink.description: Aggregated connectivity between two sites, drawn as one overworld wire. a_site_id < b_site_id.

cable_ids.description: Cables whose two ends are in these two sites.

status.description: ok = NetBox reachable, supported and answered /api/status/ within 2 s; degraded = reachable but unsupported version, or /api/status/ took longer than 2 s (slow); down = unreachable (no answer within 5 s, or not HTTP 200).

write_enabled.description: true only when the proxy runs with WRITE_ENABLED=1.

supported.description: Version is in the supported range (4.7.x for contract 2.2.0).

SiteScene.description: GET /api/scene/site/{id}. Feeds zoom levels 'site' and 'room' (room = filter by location_id client-side).

devices.description: All devices of the site, racked or not.

cables.description: Cables with at least one termination in the site; terminations elsewhere carry their own site_id.

devices.description: Devices with rack_id = this rack (position null = zero-U).

cables.description: Cables touching any device in the rack.

DeviceDetail.description: GET /api/device/{id}. Feeds zoom level 'device' and the info panel.

interfaces.description: All ports of every kind. Ordered by kind in PortKind enum order (interface, front_port, rear_port, console_port, ...), then within a kind in the order NetBox's own list endpoint returns them for this device (`GET /api/dcim/<ports>/?device_id=<id>`, NetBox's natural order, e.g. Gi1/0/24, Te1/1/1, mgmt0).

cables.description: Cables attached to any of these ports.

Ref.description: Reference to an object created by an earlier op in the same ChangeSet: '@' + that op's client_ref.

client_ref.description: Optional; unique within the ChangeSet; echoed in the result; lets later ops point at a created object as '@<client_ref>'.

if_unmodified_since.description: Optional optimistic lock: the target's last_updated as the client saw it. A newer last_updated in NetBox makes the op fail with code 'conflict'.

UnplaceDeviceOp.description: Clears rack, position and face; the device stays in its site and location.

UpdateFieldsOp.description: Edit plain fields. The proxy accepts only the whitelist in contracts/api.md#update_fields per kind and answers validation_failed for anything else.

ChangeSet.description: Body of POST /api/changes/preview and POST /api/changes/apply. Ops run in order.

reason.description: Optional note; the proxy logs it with the apply.

id.description: Resolved target. Preview: the request's id, or the request's '@<client_ref>' string unchanged when the target was created by an earlier op of the same ChangeSet; null for create_rack. Apply: always the real NetBox id.

status.description: skipped = not run because an earlier op failed during apply.

before.description: The touched fields before (contract field names); null for create_rack.

after.description: The touched fields after (predicted in preview, read back from NetBox after apply).

applied.description: true only if mode=apply and every op ended ok/no_change.

PlayerId.description: The player's NetBox user id; 0 only in the single-user local mode (RACKWALKER_LOCAL_PLAYER=1).

Player.description: The signed-in player: a NetBox user, as NetBox reported it at sign-in.

display_name.description: NetBox first and last name, or null when NetBox has neither.

GameSession.description: Who is playing. GET /api/game/session always answers 200 with this body.

csrf_token.description: Send it back as the X-RackWalker-CSRF header on every game write. null when signed out.

local_mode.description: true when the proxy runs the single-user local mode (no NetBox sign-in; off by default).

SignInRequest.description: Sign in as a NetBox user with one of that user's NetBox API tokens. The proxy asks NetBox who owns the token, then forgets the token: it is never stored, logged or used again.

HintLevel.description: How often the guide speaks up: off = never on her own (the menu still opens her), low = only first-time essentials, normal = also when you seem stuck, high = also extra tips.

KeyBindings.description: Up to three keys per action. up/down/left/right walk on the overworld; interact talks and chooses, and inside a building enters the selected object; cancel closes and goes back (inside a building: one level out); menu opens the menu; zoom_in, zoom_out, search, rotate (a rack), trace (a port), unrack (a device) and undo (with Ctrl or Cmd held) act inside buildings. Added in 2.2.0 and optional, so settings written before 2.2.0 stay valid: zoom_in, zoom_out, search, rotate, trace, unrack, undo. The proxy fills a missing one with its default (the player's own keys win over a default that clashes with them) on every read and write.

KeyList.description: KeyboardEvent.code values (layout-independent), e.g. ArrowUp, KeyW, Space.

reduce_motion.description: Text appears at once and scene changes cut instead of sliding.

SaveSlotId.description: auto = the autosave slot the game writes on every change of place; 1-3 = manual slots.

SaveData.description: Where the player is. Small on purpose: everything else is re-read from NetBox.

overworld.title: OverworldPos
overworld.description: Overworld tile the player stands on and the way they face.

view.description: The isometric level, in the ?view= deep-link form.

iso.description: The building the player is in (scene iso), else null.

Flags.description: Dialogue and story flags (e.g. ilatea.intro.seen). Open on purpose: names come from the dialogue scripts.

flags.description: Flags to set; null deletes a flag.

GameState.description: Everything the game stores for the signed-in player. Never written into NetBox.

message.description: One human sentence. Never contains the NetBox token.

details.description: Machine detail, e.g. {"field": "position", "reason": "U12 occupied by device 31"}.

ErrorResponse.description: The one error shape for every non-2xx response.
